About MapClimb Marketing

A Knoxville team built to move local businesses up the map

MapClimb Marketing is a Local SEO agency based in Knoxville, Tennessee. We serve local businesses all over the country, mainly home services: roofers, plumbers, HVAC companies, electricians, restoration companies and contractors.

  1. Home
  2. /

Our Story

Built for owners who want the phone to ring, not more guesswork

MapClimb was built around a simple idea. A local business should not have to guess whether its marketing is working. When a homeowner needs a roofer, a plumber or an HVAC company, they search on Google, look at the first few businesses on the map and call one. We want that call to be yours.

So we keep the work focused on what moves rankings and brings in calls: on page and off page SEO done together, a website built to rank and to turn visits into calls, and a clear report every month that shows where you rank, what moved and what we worked on.

We have built hundreds of SEO optimized websites for local businesses. Every one is built around the services a business offers and the areas it covers.

We are based in Knoxville, Tennessee, and our clients are spread all over the country.

Our Mission

Make your business the first call in your area

Our mission is to put your business in the top 3 on Google Maps and organic search for the jobs you want, in the areas you serve, and to make sure it looks like the right choice once people find it.

Rankings you can see

Every month you get a keyword report that shows every move, up or down, and the work we did that month.

Plain talk

No jargon. Every update tells you what we did, why it matters and what is next on the list.

Both sides of SEO

On page and off page SEO done together, with your website built in, so every piece pushes the same way.

A guaranteed start

100% Guaranteed. Keyword ranking results in your first 30 days.

How We Work

Four steps from your first call to the top 3

The steps stay the same from client to client. The work inside them is shaped by your market, your services and the searches your customers type.

01

Intro call

A quick call about your business, your services and the areas you cover. We tell you straight if we are a fit.

02

Onboarding

A short form gets us your locations, services, keywords, how far you travel for jobs and the look you want for your website.

03

Build and launch

We build your website to rank and to turn visits into calls, set up your Google Business Profile the right way and go live.

04

Monthly reporting

On page and off page SEO every month, plus a clear report of your keyword rankings and the work we did.

Industries

How each trade gets hired

A burst pipe gets a call in minutes. A new roof gets compared for weeks. We plan around that.

Plumbing, HVAC and Electrical

These calls are often urgent. A homeowner with no heat or a leak calls one of the first businesses they see on the map, so we push hard for the top 3.

PlumbingHVACElectrical

Roofing

A roof is a big decision. Homeowners compare a few companies, read your website and check how you look online before they call.

Roofing

Restoration

Water, fire and mold damage searches come from people who need help fast. We focus on the map pack and a website that makes calling easy.

Restoration

General Contractors

Remodels, additions and repairs are planned projects. Owners research longer, so strong service pages and city pages carry more weight.
